chapter.name: thugs rje dpyang thag gnas kyi lung bstan pa ste dang po
mdzad pa cho 'phrul lha'i lung bstan pa ste gnyis pa
'phrin las mthar phyin pa bsgrub pa'i lung bstan pa ste gsum pa
gsang sngags nges pa don gyi lung bstan pa ste bzhi pa
gsal bar byed pa sgron ma'i lung bstan pa ste lnga pa
